Method of Attack: Exploited zero-day remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2023-0669) to gain unauthorized access and steal customer data
Used by Clop ransomware gang to steal data and extort victims
Impacted Systems: Over 130 organizations targeted by Clop ransomware gang
Attack Vector: Zero-day vulnerability in GoAnywhere MFT software allowing remote code execution
Indicators of Compromise: Unauthorized access to Fortra’s GoAnywhere site
Data breach notifications filed with Attorney General's offices
Exploit publicly released before emergency patch on February 7, 2023
